plays.summary: Navy blue's centre-back steps in to win the ball near the edge of the box and lays it off to the central midfielder to launch a counterattack.

players.note: Virgil van Dijk-like composure stepping in cleanly at the edge of the box and immediately playing forward to start the counter.
Luka Modric-style awareness to receive under pressure and open up space for a forward pass.

plays.summary: Navy blue's central midfielder plays a long ball over the top to the striker, who outmuscles a defender into the box and forces a save.

players.note: Kevin De Bruyne-style vision to spot the early run and clip an accurate ball over the backline.
Erling Haaland-like physicality to hold off the defender at full speed and get a clean shot on target.

plays.summary: Navy blue's central midfielder threads a pass down the right channel for the right winger, who drives toward the box before losing possession.

players.note: Toni Kroos-like weight of pass into space to stretch the opponent's backline.
When isolated near the corner of the box against a set defender, look to cut back or lay the ball off to supporting midfielders instead of forcing a 1v1.

plays.summary: Navy blue presses high to win possession on the far touchline and builds through midfield to the edge of the box before the final pass is cut out.

players.note: N'Golo Kante-like anticipation to press the touchline, win possession, and recycle the ball cleanly.
Sergio Busquets-style patience to circulate possession and thread a vertical pass into the attacking third.
Check shoulders before receiving at the edge of the box and play a quicker one-touch layoff rather than taking extra touches into traffic.

plays.summary: Navy blue's centre-back dives into a central challenge outside the defensive penalty area and concedes a dangerous free kick.

players.note: Stay on your feet, jockey the ball carrier, and delay until midfield cover arrives instead of lunging in and conceding a set piece outside the box.

plays.summary: Navy blue defends a free kick into the box, wins the second ball under pressure, and passes cleanly out to the left wing.

players.note: Ruben Dias-like concentration to attack the second ball in the box and find a teammate rather than panicking.

plays.summary: Navy blue's central midfielder wins the ball near halfway and hits a diagonal pass for the right winger, who attacks the box to win a corner kick.

players.note: Xabi Alonso-like transition play to win the ball in midfield and immediately launch an accurate diagonal ball into space.
Bukayo Saka-style direct running to attack the space behind the full-back and earn a dangerous corner kick.

plays.summary: Navy blue loses possession quickly from a restart on the right flank, forcing a recovery run to disrupt the counterattack near the box.

players.note: Protect the ball on restarts and play the simple safe pass into open space instead of turning into pressure.
Kyle Walker-like recovery speed to track back and disrupt the opponent's shot at the edge of the box.

plays.summary: Navy blue launches a long free kick from deep, secures the second ball, and threads a through ball into the box for a clinical goal.

players.note: Trent Alexander-Arnold-like delivery from deep to bypass the midfield press and put the attack on the front foot.
Bernardo Silva-like composure to secure the bouncing second ball and move it centrally into a dangerous pocket.
Martin Odegaard-style disguise and weight on the final through ball to split the defence.
Harry Kane-like timing on the run into the box and clinical first-time finish past the goalkeeper.
